Started in software development, I shifted to cybersecurity after realizing the growing need to protect digital infrastructure. Over 13 years, I’ve evolved from building backend systems to securing them against evolving threats. My journey reflects a commitment to blending technical rigor with proactive defense strategies.  

Today, I focus on architecting resilient systems at CyberShield Technologies. My work spans CI/CD pipelines that integrate Docker and PostgreSQL for scalable, secure deployments. Python and Redis power real-time analytics, while AWS underpins our cloud-native infrastructure. I’ve led migrations to Kubernetes, designing microservices that balance performance with compliance. Mentorship is key—guiding teams on REST API security and Terraform-driven infrastructure as code.  

Architected solutions that reduced breach risks by 40% in high-stakes projects. My approach merges automation with human insight, ensuring systems adapt to both technical and organizational challenges.  

Let’s connect if you’re building secure systems or exploring new ways to protect digital infrastructure. Open to collaborations that push the boundaries of secure, scalable engineering.
